_comment: The first-run setup's steps and the news shown after an update, in one place.
Read by SetupWizard.qml (what it shows) and by b1air-settings (--first-run:
whether to open it; --setup-baseline: what an account set up by hand has seen).
steps[].version: raise it when a step gains something worth showing again;
everyone who saw an older version sees the step once more.
steps[].needs: hardware the step is about ('wifi', 'fingerprint'); no such
steps[].baseline: the version an account that predates the setup counts as
seen (it set those things up by hand); absent: not seen, shown at next login.
news[]: what an update added outside the setup's steps, by release; each item
names a Settings page to open. Shown once, after an update, never after an
install. The text is English and translated through Ui/i18n like the rest.

items.text: Language & Region: the language other programs use, and the formats of dates and numbers apart from the language
Lock & Login: locking, the fingerprint and the login screen on one page
Privacy: screen time, clipboard history, the trash and stored locations, and wiping them
Top Bar: which tiles the Control Center shows, and the weather
Updates and Storage & Backup are two pages now
Zed opens on Super+I in place of Notes; the monitor, text editor and camera have keys
A dock at the bottom of the screen: turn it on in Top Bar → Dock
Focus modes in place of Do Not Disturb: Work, Personal, Sleep and Gaming, each with the apps it lets through
Hot corners: hold the pointer in a corner for the overview, the Launchpad or the Control Center
Light by day and dark by night, turning with the sunset
Files: colour tags, column and gallery views, thumbnails of photos and videos
Files shows an iPod, an iPhone or an Android phone as a device: an iPod's music and playlists, a phone's photos, shared files and backup
